tools.name: 360learning_list_users
tools.description: List users in the platform. Filter by email, username or status. Needs scope users:read. GET /api/v2/users.

tools.name: 360learning_get_user
tools.description: Get one user by id, with profile, status and custom fields. Needs scope users:read. GET /api/v2/users/{userId}.

tools.name: 360learning_list_groups
tools.description: List all groups (teams) in the platform. Needs scope groups:read. GET /api/v2/groups.

tools.name: 360learning_get_group
tools.description: Get one group by id. Needs scope groups:read. GET /api/v2/groups/{groupId}.

tools.name: 360learning_list_group_members
tools.description: List the users and roles (admin, coach, learner, ...) in one group. Needs scope groups:read. GET /api/v2/groups/{groupId}/roles.

tools.name: 360learning_add_user_role_to_group
tools.description: Give a user a role in a group (for example learner or coach). Adding a role the user already has changes nothing. Needs scope groups:write. POST /api/v2/groups/{groupId}/{role}/{userId}.

tools.name: 360learning_remove_user_role_from_group
tools.description: Remove a role from a user in a group. The user loses the access the role gives. Needs scope groups:write. DELETE /api/v2/groups/{groupId}/{role}/{userId}.

tools.name: 360learning_list_courses
tools.description: List courses. Filter by status, type, group or author. Needs scope courses:read. GET /api/v2/courses.

tools.name: 360learning_get_course
tools.description: Get one course by id. Needs scope courses:read. GET /api/v2/courses/{courseId}.

tools.name: 360learning_list_course_stats
tools.description: List course attempt statistics. Filter by course or user. Needs scope courseStats:read. GET /api/v2/courses/stats.

tools.name: 360learning_list_paths
tools.description: List learning paths. Filter by status. Needs scope paths:read. GET /api/v2/paths.

tools.name: 360learning_get_path
tools.description: Get one learning path by id. Needs scope paths:read. GET /api/v2/paths/{pathId}.

tools.name: 360learning_list_path_sessions
tools.description: List the sessions (cohorts) of one learning path. Needs scope paths:read. GET /api/v2/paths/{pathId}/sessions.

tools.name: 360learning_list_path_enrollments
tools.description: List who is enrolled in a learning path, and in which session. Needs scope paths:read. GET /api/v2/paths/{pathId}/enrollments.

tools.name: 360learning_get_path_session_stats
tools.description: Get aggregated learner statuses for one path session. Needs scope pathStats:read. GET /api/v2/paths/{pathId}/sessions/{sessionId}/user-statuses.

tools.name: 360learning_list_classrooms
tools.description: List classrooms (live sessions). Filter by group. Needs scope classrooms:read. GET /api/v2/classrooms.

tools.name: 360learning_list_custom_fields
tools.description: List the custom fields defined for users, courses or paths. Needs scope customFields:read. GET /api/v2/custom-fields.

tools.name: 360learning_list_projects
tools.description: List the projects of the platform. Needs scope projects:read. GET /api/v2/projects.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: 360learning_list_users · Public sink: 360learning_list_users, 360learning_add_user_role_to_group · Destructive: 360learning_remove_user_role_from_group.
findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
